about_short_description.short_description: Fieldproxy is a SaaS platform that lets business owners build custom apps to streamline their field operations.

product.name: AI Powered Builder
product.description: An AI-driven tool that converts user workflows into custom field service mobile apps and backend portals within hours.

product.name: Fully Customizable Mobile Apps
product.description: Mobile applications for field technicians that support job reporting, inventory tracking, dynamic forms, and asset management.

product.name: Powerful Operations Portals
product.description: Backend portals for scheduling, dispatch, quote generation, service agreements, and financial tracking.

product.name: AI Agents
product.description: A suite of AI tools that automate root cause analysis, route tracking, and complex scheduling based on technician skillsets.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Connectors that link Fieldproxy with existing CRMs, helpdesk, accounting, and inventory management systems.

product.name: Automations
product.description: Custom workflow automations for SLA alerts, contract expiry reminders, follow-ups, and other operational tasks.
